rationale: FirstLight Power's U.S. operations form one manager-level power platform. ECP created the platform in November 2006, GDF SUEZ acquired it in December 2008, and PSP completed its 100% acquisition on June 1, 2016. PSP signed a sale of the U.S. operations to Hull Street Energy on May 19, 2026, but FERC EC26-110 remained pending as of the cutoff; PSP therefore remains the current legal owner and Hull Street is pending only.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical FirstLight Power U.S. platform record; use the requested FirstLight USA, LLC identity only if that exact legal name is preserved by the canonical repository convention.
Record ECP/Energy Capital Partners I as former owner from November 2006 to December 29, 2008; do not invent an exact November 1 entry date.
Record GDF SUEZ/ENGIE as former 100% owner from December 29, 2008 to June 1, 2016.
Record PSP Investments as the active 100% owner from June 1, 2016.
Record Hull Street Energy Partners III as a signed pending incoming owner, not an active owner.
Do not merge unrelated FirstLight Fiber or separately count subsidiary generation assets.
unresolvedQuestions: The exact internal reorganization date from PSP H2O FL USA LLC to the current FirstLight Holding/PSP FL USA chain is not publicly disclosed.
The Hull Street closing date, post-closing top company and any platform combination remain unresolved because the sale was unclosed at the cutoff.
